value.description: A value that can be accepted or returned by TensorFlow APIs. Accepted types for `value` include `tf.Tensor`, any value that can be converted to `tf.Tensor` using `tf.convert_to_tensor`, and any subclass of `CompositeTensor` (such as `tf.RaggedTensor`).
constraints: Accepted types for `value` include `tf.Tensor`, any value that can be converted to `tf.Tensor` using `tf.convert_to_tensor`, and any subclass of `CompositeTensor` (such as `tf.RaggedTensor`).
value must be one of tf.Tensor, tf.convert_to_tensor, CompositeTensor, tf.RaggedTensor
Returns a `tf.TypeSpec` that represents the given `value`.
